name: IIT Kharagpur

about.text: IIT Kharagpur is India’s premier institute that is excelling in nurturing students with excellent academic knowledge, top-class research facilities and industry exposure. The institution was founded on 18 August 1951 and it was the first IIT that was established with the support of the Indian government. The institution is located in the West Bengal in Kharagpur. The campus covers all the facilities for their scholars and learners, including state-of-the-art facilities, high-tech research laboratories, student clubs, sports clubs, libraries stacked with resources and various organisations and student groups that activity participates in the extracurricular activities. It offers various undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, certificate and doctoral programs to the students.

It provides interdisciplinary programs, minor courses that can be completed online mode in a short duration, micro-specialisation courses, along on-campus regular mode courses. It offers nearly 15+ B.Tech programs, 67 programs which include MBA, MHRM, LLB, MMST, MCP, M.Sc/ M.Tech/ MS, 35 programs which include a course in B.Arch, several Dual Degrees and many PhD programs.

IIT Kharagpur has a variety of courses offered through faculties like Faculty of Engineering and Architecture, Faculty of Interdisciplinary Sciences & Engineering, Faculty of Humanities, Social & Economic Sciences, School of Management, Faculty of Inter-Disciplinary and Biotechnology & Biosciences, Faculty of Sciences, School of Law and many more. Students can pursue courses in many disciplines like Engineering and Technology, Management, Law, Medical Science and Technology, Science, Humanities, Architecture and Regional Planning, Rural Development and many more.

about.text: The institute is research-oriented and encourages students to pursue and conduct research in various fields. The institute is engaged in many research programs and projects and has collaborated with various national and international institutions and organisations. It has many research labs that are high-tech and equipped with modern facilities. It is conducting research in technologies like robotics, nanotechnology, artificial intelligence, and biotechnology.

IIT Kharagpur is approved by the Ministry of Human Resource & Development, Government of India. It is accredited by the National Board of Accreditation and also by the All India Council for Technical Education. As per the National Institutional Ranking Framework 2025, the institution is ranked 5th in the engineering category with a 78.69 score .

admission.text: Admission at IIT KGP is an amazing institute and every year, many students enrol in this institute to complete their higher education. They need to appear in the All India Examinations like JAM, JEE, GATE, UGC-CSIR and many more. Also, it is mandatory for the students to clear the cutoffs and attend counselling and personal interview sessions at the institution. Then candidates can follow the steps mentioned below.
Step 1- Make an online registration on the website of the IIT KGP. Use a functional phone number and email ID.
Step 2- Now, you need to move to the next step which is the completion of the two-step verification.
Step 3- Fill in all the details left and check them twice before moving to the next step.
Step 4- Now, you can move to the step of uploading the relevant documents.
Step 5- Make online payment and complete the final submission of the form. Download the application form and take a print of the same.

examination.text: Examination at IIT Kharagpur is done in online mode. It is an amazing institute that allows students to study in a flexible mode. The institute offers online study material to the students that allows students to learn from anywhere. They conduct examinations in online mode with proper proctoring. The students are not required to visit the campus. They can appear in online examinations from their respective places or states. But before applying to the institute make sure to read all the guidelines and follow them. Submit the examination on the stipulated time frame and check the schedule of the test on the official website.

placementText.text: The Institute is globally recognised for its excellent faculty and services. It has facilitated placement drives with the help of top recruiters and MNCs. The Students are trained with excellent academic skills and practical knowledge that makes them industry-ready and eases to handle fresh exposure in the industry. Also, students enrolled in online courses at IITs are well-versed in the basic knowledge that helps them fetch a job in the industry with ease and that too, with the right guidance by the experts. They have an amazing record of offering placements to more than 95% of students every year. Some top recruiters of the institute are Google, Deloitte, KPMG, HCL, Dell, Accenture and many more.
